Returning in 2027.

Your Happiness. Our Passion.

Sunflowers radiate joy & happiness, just like one act of kindness can bring to our lives. Project Sunflower promotes mental wellness and joy across our communities and stands to bring happiness to schools and healthcare facilities.

That is the work coming back in 2027. We gather flowers that would otherwise be thrown away after weddings and events, arrange them into small bedside bouquets, and deliver them to hospital patients and nursing home residents around Birmingham. We are rebuilding now, and the deliveries start again in 2027.

How it works

From the end of a celebration to the start of someone’s better day.

  1. One

    Gather

    When a wedding or event ends, venues and florists set aside flowers that are still fresh instead of sending them to landfill. We collect them the same day or the next morning.

  2. Two

    Arrange

    Volunteers sort, trim, and refresh the stems, then build small, cheerful bedside arrangements, sized for a hospital tray table, not a banquet hall.

  3. Three

    Deliver

    The bouquets go out to partner hospitals and nursing homes in the Birmingham area, delivered to patients and residents who could use a lift.

What we do

Flowers and gifts, delivered to brighten a hospital day.

Our mission is to bring joy and happiness to patients and hospital personnel by delivering flowers and gifts to brighten their stressful days.

For patients

A visit, in the form of flowers

Hospital patients often lack visitors and emotional care. Once a month, we deliver flowers and gifts with positive messages, to instill hope and help patients feel loved.

Partners and sponsors

Gathered with wedding and event planners

We partner with wedding and event planners to gather supplies, including flowers, gifts, and note cards. Sponsoring planners can include their business cards, attached to the gift boxes and bouquets we deliver.

Monthly deliveries

Once a month

Deliveries happen once a month. Hospital departments are contacted weeks in advance, so each delivery can be accommodated.

For students

Community and volunteering

It gives students community and the opportunity to work and volunteer in healthcare settings.
